readme:
# GCam Custom Shutter Sound

An Xposed/LSPosed module that replaces the **Google Camera** shutter sound with
your own audio clip.

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound?label=download)](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/releases/latest)
[![Build](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**Source code:** https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound

Google Camera plays its shutter through `SoundPool`, loading the bundled
resource `R.raw.camera_shutter`. This module hooks `SoundPool.load(...)` inside
the GCam process: when GCam loads that resource, the module loads your clip
instead and returns its sample id, so GCam's own `play()` emits your sound.

## Requirements

- Rooted Android with **LSPosed** or a compatible framework (e.g. Vector).
- Google Camera (`com.google.android.GoogleCamera`).
- Tested on Pixel 9 (Android 15).

## Install

1. Download the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/releases/latest)
   (or build it, see below) and install it.
2. In your Xposed manager, **enable the module** and set its **scope** to
   Google Camera.
3. Force-stop and reopen Google Camera, then take a photo.

### Enable from the command line (LSPosed/Vector CLI)

```sh
vector-cli modules enable io.github.vitalto.gcamshutter
vector-cli scope set io.github.vitalto.gcamshutter com.google.android.GoogleCamera/0
```

## Use your own sound

Replace `app/src/main/assets/custom_shutter.ogg` with your clip (keep the file
name) and rebuild. `SoundPool` detects the format from content, so `.ogg`,
`.mp3` or `.wav` all work under that name — `.ogg` is recommended for a short,
latency-free click.

## Build

### Gradle (Android Studio / CI)

```sh
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
# -> app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk  (sign it)
```

### Offline, no Gradle

Needs only the Android SDK command-line tools and a JDK:

```sh
export ANDROID_SDK=/path/to/Android/Sdk
bash tools/build.sh
# -> build/GCamCustomShutter.apk  (signed with a throwaway key)
```

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# GCam 自定义快门声音

一个 Xpose/LSPosed 模块，可替换 **Google Camera** 快门声音
您自己的音频剪辑。

[![发布](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound?label=download)](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/releases/latest)
[![构建](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![许可证：麻省理工学院](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](许可证)

**源代码：** https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound

谷歌相机通过“SoundPool”播放快门，加载捆绑的
资源“R.raw.camera_shutter”。该模块在内部挂钩 `SoundPool.load(...)`
GCam 进程：当 GCam 加载该资源时，模块会加载您的剪辑
相反并返回其样本 ID，因此 GCam 自己的“play()”会发出您的声音。

## 要求

- 使用 **LSPosed** 或兼容框架（例如 Vector）进行 Root 的 Android。
- 谷歌相机（`com.google.android.GoogleCamera`）。
- 在 Pixel 9 (Android 15) 上测试。

## 安装

1. 从[Releases](https://github.com/vitalto/gcam-shutter-sound/releases/latest)下载APK
   （或构建它，见下文）并安装它。
2. 在您的 Xposed 管理器中，**启用该模块**并将其**范围**设置为
   谷歌相机。
3. 强制停止并重新打开 Google 相机，然后拍照。

### 从命令行启用 (LSPosed/Vector CLI)

````嘘
矢量-cli 模块启用 io.github.vitalto.gcamshutter
矢量-cli 范围设置 io.github.vitalto.gcamshutter com.google.android.GoogleCamera/0
````

## 使用你自己的声音

将 `app/src/main/assets/custom_shutter.ogg` 替换为您的剪辑（保留文件
名称）并重建。 `SoundPool` 从内容中检测格式，因此 `.ogg`，
`.mp3` 或 `.wav` 都可以使用该名称 - 建议使用较短的 `.ogg`，
无延迟点击。

## 构建

### Gradle（Android Studio / CI）

````嘘
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
# -> app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk （签名）
````

### 离线，没有 Gradle

仅需要 Android SDK 命令行工具和 JDK：

````嘘
导出 ANDROID_SDK=/path/to/Android/Sdk
bash 工具/build.sh
# -> build/GCamCustomShutter.apk（使用一次性密钥签名）
````

## 许可证

麻省理工学院 — 请参阅[许可证]（许可证）。
